readings: Group the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by announcement timing (`eventannotm`), treating a missing timing as its own group, and compute each group's average institutional ownership (`instownpct`), ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the simple average of these group averages, each timing group counting equally. For the groups whose average is strictly above that baseline, give in one row the mean of their averages and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline, without rounding. queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
  HAVING COUNT(instownpct) > 0
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_own) AS baseline FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_own) AS mean_of_averages,
       AVG(g.avg_own - b.baseline) AS mean_excess
FROM g, b
WHERE g.avg_own > b.baseline;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN eventannotm IS NULL OR eventannotm = '' THEN NULL ELSE eventannotm END
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_avg, AVG(g.a - b.base) AS mean_excess
FROM g, b
WHERE g.a > b.base;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_own) AS baseline
  FROM g
  WHERE avg_own IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_own) AS mean_of_averages,
       AVG(g.avg_own - b.baseline) AS mean_excess
FROM g, b
WHERE g.avg_own > b.baseline;
